newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Aerospace signs US$55 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: China Aerospace signs US$55 mln loan.

text.p: China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd (CASIL) said on Tuesday it signed a US$55 million term loan facility agreement with 10 international banks.
The facility carries a maturity of two years with an additional one-year extension option and pays a margin of 140 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate, CASIL said in a statement.
CASIL said the loan would be used primarily for investment in hi-tech projects and business development.
The projects included the HAX-SP1 260,000 Lines Super Switching System, ATM large scale Digital Switching System and Direct-to-home Satellite Broadcasting receivers.
Also included were the Jiansu cable digital radio and television broadcasting joint venture project and the Zhejian province GPS join venture project.
Arrangers and underwriters are Banca Commerciale Italiana Hong Kong branch and Banque Indosuez Hong Kong branch.
China Merchants Bank is the co-arranger and co-underwriter.

Other participants are China Construction Bank Hong Kong branch, Banca di Roma Shanghai branch, Yien Yieh Commercial Bank Hong Kong branch, KEB (Asia) Finance, LTCB Hong Kong, CARIPLO Hong Kong branch and Centrobanca SpA-Banca Centrale di Credito Popolare Milano branch.
